title: GEOLOGIA competitive benchmark matrix v2
methodology: public-domain teardown: official docs, white papers, release notes, papers only; no decompilation; closed-platform claims limited to what public materials confirm
our_position_summary: not competing on modelling engines; competing on auditable evidence layer + Arabic-first bilingualism + honest refusal; only conceptual competitor: GeoGPT (DDE) — 2026 peer-reviewed critique (Journal of Geoethics, DOI 10.4401/jgsg-119) confirms IUGS suspension of DDE and open-interface-closed-core; 2026 research trend (provenance-aware GraphRAG, AEVS) validates our evidence-fingerprint architecture

platforms.name: GemPy v3
platforms.standout: latest stable 2026.0.3: GPU implicit cokriging, Bayesian uncertainty via autodiff, PyTorch support, GemGIS/pyGIMLi/SimPEG ecosystem, LiquidEarth viewer
platforms.our_position: future hosted engine behind certification gate (roadmap phase 4)
platforms.borrowed_lesson: probabilistic outputs must be traceable; adopt after trusted-data layer

platforms.name: LoopStructural
platforms.standout: generic API over pandas/numpy, sequential tectonic evolution
platforms.our_position: phase-4 target alongside GemPy
platforms.borrowed_lesson: geological-time-aware task ledger sequencing

platforms.name: GemGIS
platforms.standout: QGIS-to-model bridge
platforms.our_position: phase-2 complement reusing our existing readers
platforms.borrowed_lesson: reader reuse across toolchains

platforms.name: BGS Groundhog
platforms.standout: national-survey geological tool (legacy, unsupported)
platforms.our_position: gap left by its retirement
platforms.borrowed_lesson: survey tools die without sustained funding; adoption/license model is the sustainability guarantee

platforms.name: Software Underground / awesome-open-geoscience
platforms.standout: global community, yearly Transform tutorials
platforms.our_position: no community yet (assessment W5)
platforms.borrowed_lesson: build an Arab community of practice starting from partner universities

platforms.name: OSDU Data Platform
platforms.standout: maturing standard with accelerating adoption; Houston summit Dec 2025, Oslo summit Apr 2026
platforms.our_position: complementary evidence layer, not a distribution platform
platforms.borrowed_lesson: record-level licensing and governed schemas map onto our license-purpose matrix (T1)

platforms.name: GeoGPT
platforms.standout: structured literature extraction; expanding (paleontological classification assistant, May 2025)
platforms.our_position: direct conceptual competitor to Ali; 2026 peer-reviewed critique (Cleverley et al., Journal of Geoethics, DOI 10.4401/jgsg-119): DDE suspended by IUGS in early 2025, proprietary core, undisclosed content filtering, 'state-anchored international platform'
platforms.borrowed_lesson: counter-position confirmed: sovereign, auditable core with acceptance gates, fingerprints, mandatory truth classes; avoid hosted-LLM dependence without an evidence path

platforms.name: K2 + GeoBench
platforms.standout: LLaMA fine-tuned on geoscience literature; GeoBench objective + subjective questions (first geoscience benchmark)
platforms.our_position: T3 golden questions follow the same measure-before-capability philosophy
platforms.borrowed_lesson: external benchmark alignment (GeoBench-style) once T3 stabilizes

platforms.name: Geo-MAG / GeoRAG
platforms.standout: knowledge-graph-enhanced retrieval improves spatial QA
platforms.our_position: memory architecture (Source Library, Evidence Store, Knowledge Graph, Long-term Memory) already specifies this; implementation pending
platforms.borrowed_lesson: KG edges must carry evidence fingerprints, not just links

platforms.name: Leapfrog Geo
platforms.standout: relational models dynamically updated as data integrates (public materials)
platforms.our_position: adds what it lacks: provenance and evidence per claim
platforms.borrowed_lesson: model freshness via deterministic full recompute from frozen inputs

platforms.name: Petrel / DELFI
platforms.standout: AI-powered workflows; Shell partnership announced 2025
platforms.our_position: not competing on breadth; narrow certified engines first
platforms.borrowed_lesson: breadth is dangerous for a small core; three separate certificates (security/validity/science) confirmed as needed

platforms.name: GeoModeller
platforms.standout: gravity/magnetics-informed implicit surfaces
platforms.our_position: phase-6 reference point
platforms.borrowed_lesson: physics-constrained surfaces belong in the phase-6 acceptance gate

platforms.name: Geoscience ANALYST
platforms.standout: visual communication of 3D data
platforms.our_position: no visualization layer yet (assessment W7)
platforms.borrowed_lesson: light visualization bound to the CRS gate when phase 2 opens

platforms.name: Aramco / Earth Science Analytics (EarthNET)
platforms.focus: ML digitization of legacy logs, rock/fluid prediction
platforms.standout: regional closed investment proving regional demand
platforms.our_position: open auditable regional platform is unclaimed space
platforms.borrowed_lesson: regional demand exists; openness plus auditability is the differentiator

platforms.name: OneGeology
platforms.focus: global unified geological map via web services
platforms.standout: 18 years in operation, initiative formally closed (2026)
platforms.our_position: third institutional lesson repeating in front of us
platforms.borrowed_lesson: even international consortia shut down; never build on a single platform/initiative; mirrors and portability are day-one design, not an afterthought

platforms.name: EGDI
platforms.focus: harmonised European geological data, maps, web services
platforms.standout: announced 2026 path: transforming data infrastructure into a knowledge infrastructure
platforms.our_position: same direction we started from day one; they are institutional with survey funding
platforms.borrowed_lesson: data-to-knowledge race is now the industry standard; our differentiator: evidence fingerprints per edge + Arabic-first

platforms.name: KoBold Metals
platforms.standout: ~USD 3B valuation (2026), moving from software into actual copper mine development
platforms.our_position: not competing; proves commercial viability of geoscience AI
platforms.borrowed_lesson: huge market confirms demand; what closed platforms do not offer: a publicly auditable evidence layer — our product

platforms.name: SGS AIGDAC
platforms.standout: first announced Gulf investment in geoscience AI
platforms.our_position: regional demand is now official; no auditable open Arabic alternative exists in the entire matrix
platforms.borrowed_lesson: the Arabic gap remains fully unclaimed; possible integration partnership, not competition

platforms.name: Provenance-aware GraphRAG + AEVS
platforms.focus: deterministic-first provenance-aware reasoning over scientific knowledge graphs; character-level provenance for LLM-built KGs
platforms.standout: Davarpanah 2026 (Computers & Geosciences) deterministic-first hybrid architecture; AEVS 2026 character-level traceability
platforms.our_position: their architecture is our shipped T2 architecture (evidence fingerprints per edge + short-quote doctrine); independent external validation
platforms.borrowed_lesson: use as external validation and alignment reference, not as a competitor

platforms.name: JiuZhou
platforms.focus: open foundation LLMs + effective pre-training framework for geoscience
platforms.standout: published in International Journal of Digital Earth (2025); extends the K2/GeoBench lineage with open-weights corpus/framework
platforms.our_position: we run roles-over-models (ADR-0008); open-weights foundations are candidates for a future local model layer
platforms.borrowed_lesson: model independence: local open-weights path behind the evidence gate, measured on T3 before adoption; Ali identity is never bound to a hosted model
